rules.text: A change to headings 8001 through 8002 from any other chapter.
A change to heading 8003 from any other heading.

(A) A change to plates, sheet or strip (including foil) of tin of heading 8007 from other goods of heading 8007 or from any other heading; or
(B) A change to tubes, pipes and tube or pipe fittings of heading 8007 from other goods of heading 8007 or from any other heading; or
(C) A change to other goods of heading 8007 from any other heading.
